coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, tail+Y, up+Z. Upright biped, inward-facing hands.

concept.reason: Published claw reconstruction inspected; wholebody reference is explicitly inferred, no extra concept needed.

scope: Original whole organism: broad torso, upright long neck, extremely long hand claws. Not isolated claw, raptor or movie character.
specimen_basis: Incomplete arm/leg/rib remains, not complete skeleton. PIN551-483 holotype manual unguals identified in Smithsonian-hosted Barsbold translation search index. Qin2023 Fig1/2 show published reconstructed claw geometry, not raw fossil photos. Whole-body anatomy inferred from relatives as NHM explicitly warns.

scale.basis: NHM species estimate, not measured complete individual. NHM says 50 cm hand claws without an explicit bone-versus-sheath measurement protocol; keratin extension uncertain.
scale.bounds_note: The 10 m museum value describes estimated anatomical length, not this upright posed bounding box. Neither soft tissue nor whole-body dimensions are claimed to be directly measured fossils.

diagnostic_targets: Broad deep potbelly, sturdy bipedal hindlimbs, upright long neck with small head; avoid slim predator torso.
Two long forearms, each ending in three separated elongate gently curved flattened claws; not strongly curled eagle talons. Hands face inward, do not pronate palms downward.
Claws project forward/down naturally without penetrating torso or floor; open negative spaces between fingers.
Shorter balancing tail than classic long-tailed predatory theropod.
uncertainties: Head, neck and trunk proportions are family-based reconstruction; colour, feathers/skin and keratin tips not directly preserved for this specimen.
No claim that claws definitely killed prey, dug soil or pulled plants; functions remain debated.
acceptance_checks: Three long hand claws each side, roots connected, no floating spikes or merged mittens.
Wide torso and long upright neck readable in four views.
Two feet support body; hands inward-facing, not palm-down zombie pose.
Four default views only, original geometry/materials.
handoff_contract: Same localdir prep/maker/QA. Maker sends fixedhash COMPLETE then stops; root asynchronous backup, retain local for integration. No maker upload/cleanup.

material_profile.colours: Artistic muted olive, warm belly, dark beak and pale horn; not a fossil colour claim
material_profile.normals: Deliberate flat faces; closed semantic source lofts, export batched into five material primitives
